control_join.key: parent_id; frozen event_id is parent_id + ':signal' or parent_id + ':control'

chronology.signal_entry: exact H1 open at the completed UTC12H confirmation timestamp
chronology.confirmation_streak_start: first completed 12H close strictly after the frozen entry_ms
chronology.next_open: first observed H1 open timestamp >= the Nth adverse 12H close timestamp
chronology.same_timestamp_entry_confirmation: cannot exit at entry; strictly post-entry closes only
chronology.gap_precedence: the original VectorBT callback marks the first next observed open before reading that bar OHLC
chronology.stale_12h: original stale flag and callback precedence retained

account_selection.fallback: intrabar_baseline when no mode meets unchanged gates
